profile.our_pattern: Our paragraph frames the construction as an architectural stack ('built in three layers', 'On top of it sits the SDC deal universe', 'The third layer is a set of design-specific trims') and then asks the reader to hold the layer metaphor while also tracking the literal filters inside each layer.

our_quotes.quote: The estimation samples are built in three layers, and it is this layering that makes the number of observations vary from one table to the next.

The third layer is a set of design-specific trims: the run-up test drops treated firms' post-announcement quarters, the event studies cap the post-window at four quarters and truncate it at the firm's next announcement, and the scrutiny validity and channel tests require at least three analyst question-and-answer turns per call.

profile.gap: The exemplars require the reader only to follow steps; ours adds a metaphorical scaffolding ('layers' stacked one 'on top of' another) the reader must decode in parallel with the actual sample rules.

side_notes: Coverage is almost entirely at the sentence/clause and word-choice level (length, chaining, nominalization, diction, cross-ref density). Inter-paragraph organization across the five 3.1 paragraphs (ordering, transitions, paragraph-level redundancy) was not examined by any of the three agents.

All findings draw from a single section (3.1, PARA1-PARA5). No agent sampled other thesis sections, so it is unknown whether the flagged complexity devices (layering metaphor, meta-commentary, 'anchor' coinage, ornate verbs) are localized to 3.1 or recur document-wide.

Guardrail-collision findings retained (a1-f3, a1-f4->merged, a1-f7, a1-f9, a1-f10, a1-f11, a2-f2->canonical, a2-f3 canonical, a2-f6, a2-f8, a3-f1, a3-f3->merged, a3-f10): each sits near load-bearing meaning (residual definition, researcher-degree-of-freedom disclosure, scope/'not re-derived', tie-break/dual-membership rule, coverage-skew mechanic, descriptive-not-findings stance). These are descriptive complexity flags only and a human must review before any edit near these spots.
